meta.title: 유리 타일 정원
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (유리 타일 정원, a glass-tile mosaic for the passage of a subway station exit (fictional public art)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 유리 타일 정원, a glass-tile mosaic for the passage of a subway station exit (fictional public art)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Subway white tile #F4F1EA with warm grout #C9C4BA and the line blue #2F6FD0 and navy #1E3D7A; the garden in a glass palette of twenty-three colours: sky blues, blossom pinks, tulip red, yellow and violet, three greens, bark browns.
rationale.type: Grandiflora One, a display face with a floral swing, for the name and the lines; Gowun Dodum for the label plate, the station sign and the counter.
rationale.motion: Tiles turn: every picture change is a wave of flips (a radial ripple from a point or a straight gust) where each tile narrows, shows its dark edge and opens on the other colour; a gust every beat in the wind scene; only the changed tiles flip as the seed grows; a glint band crosses the glass and a few tiles twinkle in place; the camera pulls back to show the wall in its corridor.
rationale.sound: Ambient at 112 BPM in E major with a soft pluck, pad, sub, kick, hats and shaker; a recorded glockenspiel note for every gust and a marimba note for every growth stage (VSCO 2 CE and VCSL, CC0), a wine glass and sparkle for the big flips, a tubular bell under the last line.
rationale.visuals: All code: one WebGL2 fragment shader draws 160 × 90 tiles (14,400) from two pictures of 160 × 90 pixels (before and after), with the flip angle per tile from the wave front and a hashed delay; the pictures are drawn by code at tile resolution and quantised to the glass palette; the corridor, the sign and the commuters are 2D.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the wall speaks in flips.
